run_text_to_image_finetuning: run stable diffusion text-to-image finetuning on a custom dataset with configurable hyperparameters
create_validation_images: create validation images from a finetuned stable diffusion pipeline using validation prompts
save_model_card: save a model card with training metadata and generated validation images for a finetuned pipeline
configure_dream_training: configure DREAM training with detail preservation for more efficient and accurate diffusion finetuning
resume_training_checkpoint: resume stable diffusion finetuning from a previous checkpoint with automatic checkpoint management
